Hello All,

I tried to display a local txt file within my shinyApp as a readme.

But I found that the long line(> 600 px) within my txt file cannot automatically wrapped in Firefox, but by default it works well on Chrome. 

I wonder if there is any workaround can archive the same both on Chrome and Firefox ?

my ui.R code look like this.

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  ...
  fluidRow(
    tabsetPanel(
      type = "tabs",
      tabPanel("ReadME",  tags$iframe(src="Readme.txt", width="600", height="600", frameBorder="0")),
  ))
))

Best regards,
Jiaqiang
